notes: Maine's All-State choral program is the MMEA 'BOC' (Band/Orchestra/Chorus) All-State Music Festival, which includes an SSAA choir and an SATB choir. As of retrieval the MMEA 'BOC All-State Audition Info' page still described the 2025-26 cycle and the general Auditions page said audition dates/locations for the upcoming year would be 'posted shortly', so no 2026-27 audition date is included here. The 2026-27 audition materials ARE published in MMEA's Four-Year Rotation document (updated May 2026), which lists 'Year C (Fall 2026)' selections and states sight singing is suspended for 2026-2027. The festival itself is confirmed for May 13-15, 2027 at UMaine, Orono.

organization.name: Maine Music Educators Association
organization.description: Maine Music Educators Association is the state music education association that organizes Maine's All-State festivals, including the BOC (Band/Orchestra/Chorus) All-State Music Festival and Jazz All-State. Choral matters are handled by the MMEA Choral Vice President (choralvp@mainemea.org).

sources.name: MMEA BOC All-State Audition Materials: Four-Year Rotation (adopted 2016, updated May 2026)

programs.name: BOC All-State Music Festival — SSAA & SATB Choirs
programs.ensemble_type: SSAA treble chorus and SATB mixed chorus
programs.description: Maine MMEA's BOC All-State Music Festival brings together auditioned high school students in band, orchestra and chorus. The choral side comprises an SSAA choir and an SATB choir, which perform a joint concert at the close of the festival at the University of Maine, Orono.

dates.title: 2027 BOC All-State Music Festival
dates.description: Held at UMaine, Orono. MMEA lists the Orchestra & Band Concert at 11:00am and the SSAA & SATB Choir Concert at 3:30pm; the site does not state which festival day the concerts fall on, so no clock time is attached to this entry.

requirements.title: Sight singing suspended for 2026-2027
requirements.description: MMEA's Four-Year Rotation document states, for both the Soprano/Tenor and Alto/Bass audition tracks, that sight singing is suspended for the 2026-2027 audition.

requirements.title: Two major scales
requirements.description: Singers sing two major scales — one ascending to assess high range and one descending to assess low range. Scales are sung legato on 'Ah' at a comfortable tempo on quarter notes. Singers hear the starting pitch for each scale before they sing.

requirements.title: Solo song drawn from 24 Italian Songs and Arias
requirements.description: Solo song selections come from '24 Italian Songs and Arias' (G. Schirmer, 1992) — Medium High Voice edition for the Soprano/Tenor track and Medium Low Voice edition for the Alto/Bass track.

requirements.title: Voice part and divisi chosen by the teacher
requirements.description: Teachers choose the preferred voice part and divisi for their student on the registration form.

requirements.title: Audition rubrics and demo materials published
requirements.description: MMEA publishes audition rubrics and demo/practice recordings in shared Google Drive folders linked from the Four-Year Rotation document, including an MMEA All-State BOC Vocal Audition Demo Video.

repertoire.title: Gia il Sole Dal Gange
repertoire.notes: Year C (Fall 2026) solo song for both the Soprano/Tenor and Alto/Bass tracks; measures 1-48. Sung from the 24 Italian Songs and Arias collection (Medium High Voice for Soprano/Tenor, Medium Low Voice for Alto/Bass).

repertoire.title: Sing We And Chant It
repertoire.notes: Year C (Fall 2026) choral assessment selection for both the Soprano/Tenor and Alto/Bass tracks.
